content: {"reasoning": "CO-97 is a contractual bundling adjustment, meaning the service is not separately payable and cannot be billed to the patient. We have already tried clean submission, medical-necessity appeal, correction/resubmission, and records — all yielding the same CO-97 three times. Peer-to-peer and retro-auth are irrelevant (this is a coding/edit bundling issue, not clinical or authorization), and further resubmissions only add costly touches without changing the bundling determination. With no new lever to overturn a contractual bundling denial, the balance should be closed as a contractual write-off.", "action": "write_off"}
